title: Canonical normalized provider telephone Session host and typed observations
platform: local macOS arm64; isolated synthetic provider connector plus real canonical QUIC/HTTP listeners and public Rust SDK

verification.name: Full Store including 28 provider Session cases
Signed native/HTTP normalized provider Session host

behavior: An exact completed generic Session invitation from the configured owning AI Participant queues the normalized provider worker. Native and HTTP replay share the original immutable control receipt and start the configured original destination once. Public Session End cleans the exact original provider resource once.

The actual configured assistant Endpoint, verified Device/address, own AI credential, telephone Endpoint/credential, route owner and secret reference are bound before dispatch. The actual Vapi driver now reports its selected secret reference rather than a hardcoded default. No application Task or retired Call command is introduced.

Typed provider_call facts use existing authorized conversation snapshots and provider_voice journal events. Original operation/Session/Participant/epoch and independent provider revisions are retained; private provider IDs/control URLs are absent. local_media remains false, and provider status never manufactures a Connection or ConnectionReady.

Exclusive owned worker custody spans dispatch, historical result capture and drain. Restart after uncertain creation retains exactly one provider attempt and reports unresolved cleanup; it does not guess a resource, redial, or turn shutdown into a pass. Only a quiescent host can be replaced, and the successor recovers pending original effects.

Missing VoiceStart refuses before provider IO. The outbound-only fixture omits VoiceDiscover and panics if called. It proves outbound/status/end independence only; incoming/discovery qualification remains open.

Original caller permission/deadline govern start. After active observation the monitor checks independent current AI/telephone/route credentials, original membership epochs, endpoint revisions/devices, Session/conversation lifetime and observer restrictions. Known owned resources remain cleanable after command/Endpoint authority loss. Unprojectable live Session role changes are refused.

Public assistant jobs now retain separate provider-terminal and owned native endpoint-drain facts. A logical forbidden/cancelled result remains visible as the operation problem and does not itself imply unconfirmed cleanup. Unknown creation/end and failed native drain cannot be called clean. Joined uncertain cleanup remains a sticky host error across repeated drains. Actual revoke-after-ready and missing-terminal-evidence fixtures cover both directions of the distinction.

A naturally terminal attributed status confirms a separate cleanup compensation effect without sending End. Existing original creation confirmation, duplicate/reordered observations, provider resource collision quarantine and private historical visibility protections remain exercised.
corrections: Initial constructor edit attached a Vapi reference field to Telnyx; corrected the exact constructor and retained the failed compiler log.

First public run refused all three hosts because connector configuration references use secret:<name>, while host composition compared a bare name. Corrected the actual account-reference comparison; final public fixtures pass.

Authority audit moved the unsupported-role check behind authorization and original receipt replay, added current membership observer/conversation/Device checks, and preserved original no-deadline-renewal behavior on recovered never-submitted intents. Fixture capture calls use the actual consuming capture API.

The new close fixture initially attempted Conversation close with a live Session; the existing invariant correctly refused it. The fixture now ends the Session through its authorized generic command before closing. No guard was relaxed. Both public and Store End fixtures read the actual current/immutable Session topology revision; the Store fixture also corrected its credential argument type. The intermediate compiler and stale-binary runs are retained.

Public AI regressions repeatedly failed shutdown and the added diagnostic reported an operational forbidden result as unconfirmed cleanup. Replaced that inference with explicit original provider and actual native endpoint cleanup facts; constructor failures also drain their own peer after releasing context reads. Added deterministic authority-loss and missing-provider-terminal cases, including repeated uncertain drains. The eleven-case final isolated public AI run passes.

A nominal accepted-public-AI initialization refused forbidden during concurrent generated-cache cleanup (ten passes/one failure). Its log is retained. A subsequent isolated run passed all eleven cases. This does not establish the cause or qualify resource-pressure initialization; the refusal remains explicit rather than being called a pass.
remaining_work: Complete verified inbound receipt import and durable discovery cursors, independent incoming/status/end operation when VoiceStart is absent, and the full five retired voice_flow functional requirements. Existing SIP cases do not substitute for the Vapi telephone requirements; the retired file remains unmigrated.

Implement positive authenticated/correlated reconciliation of uncertain creation without a resource ID, and typed provider collision/quarantine resolution. Current unknown preservation/no-redial is necessary but not full reconciliation.

Complete original Task/context grants, callback/transcript/private fanout/teardown, truthful Endpoint runtime/capability selection, actual selected trunk/secret profiles, early terminal/process-kill custody, physical Core quarantine and remaining private/multiparty/role/media matrices.

Investigate the observed nominal initialization refusal during concurrent cache cleanup without assuming the isolated pass establishes its cause; retain bounded grants and explicit not-submitted/uncertain distinctions. Complete the remaining generic Vapi chat/SIP/Telnyx/SMS integration and run designated provider/remote/native/browser/Linux profiles according to bounded G6-093 configuration. G6-045 follows G6-044 for ambiguous contact routing; CallerID is never principal authority.
not_qualified: One initialization refusal was observed during concurrent generated-cache cleanup and is not causally resolved or qualified as a resource-pressure operating profile. No full G6-044 or acceptance closure; no full workspace, Linux x86_64, browser, remote/NAT, live provider/PSTN, package, publication or independent acceptance proof. The specific operational-error/cleanup conflation has current failure and recovery evidence; other earlier shutdown/private one-frame causes remain unestablished.
